name: How does AKN Design Group ensure quality and craftsmanship in large-scale remodels?

mainEntity.name: How does AKN Design Group ensure quality and craftsmanship in large-scale remodels?

acceptedAnswer.text: AKN Design Group ensures quality and craftsmanship through our integrated design-build process and unwavering commitment to core values. With over two decades of experience and more than 10,000 jobs completed, our team manages every phase, from detailed CAD-supported layouts to construction and final finishes. Anthony Nusbaumer's leadership emphasizes honesty, reliability, and craftsmanship, which are foundational to every project. This approach provides a single, accountable team dedicated to delivering customized renovations that reflect our high standards, building trust and lasting impressions with every homeowner.
acceptedAnswer.description: AKN Design Group ensures quality through an integrated design-build process and core values like honesty and craftsmanship. Our experienced team manages every phase, providing a single accountable point for high-standard customized renovations.
